name: Unobserved task failure diagnostics carry an ExceptionContext

input.source_text: class A { public async fun fail() -> Nil { raise :x } } let t = A.new().fail(); let all = Diagnostics.unobserved_failures(); let e = all[0]; [all.length(), e[1], e[2]]

applicability.reason: The diagnostic event payload is observable after an unobserved async failure.
